engine.name: ASM Hydrasynth
engine.description: ASM Hydrasynth Keyboard and Desktop wave-morphing synthesizer: every parameter of ASM's MIDI NRPN specification, sent as NRPN (the instrument's Param RX set to NRPN).

sources.title: Hydrasynth MIDI NRPN & CC Communication Spec, firmware 1.5
sources.notes: NRPN table (pages 3 - 26) and rhythm lists (pages 26, 27) read by tools/profiles/asm/read-asm-nrpn.mjs from Hydrasynth_KB_DR_MIDI_Spec_1.5.0.pdf (sha256 f86b31024d7b79c2ca648e9977104f9909383cc9c560092918f2ed899871416b), https://www.mecldata.com/download/asm/legacy/Hydrasynth_KB_DR_MIDI_Spec_1.5.0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/asm/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/asm/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of ASM's NRPN specification, sent as that NRPN with a 14-bit value: VV (the data MSB) on CC 6 and WW (the data LSB) on CC 38. The instrument's MIDI page 6 must have Param RX set to NRPN. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The specification is for firmware 1.5. Later firmware adds parameters it does not list; those are not here.

Where one NRPN is several parameters, told apart by VV (`when VV=01H ,set OSC2 Mode`), each is sent correctly, but CEditor does not follow them when the instrument sends them: an incoming NRPN is matched by its number alone.

Rows the spec prints wrongly, corrected by the layout: LFO4 Smooth (printed VV=07H, as Steps is: 06H, as LFO 1 - 3); LFO5 Smooth (printed VV=08H: 06H, as LFO 1 - 3); LFO5 Steps (printed VV=08H: 07H, as LFO 1 - 3).
Names corrected from the spec: printed `BMP Sync` (LFO 1 - 5); printed `marco1 panel value` … `marco8 panel value`; words a line break split (`BP M`, `One- Shot`) joined.

Left out, settings whose values depend on the effect type, which the spec does not list: PRE-FX preset, PRE-FX Param3, PRE-FX Param4, PRE-FX Param5, Sidechn type(when PRE-FX type is compress), POST-FX preset, POST-FX Param3, POST-FX Param4, POST-FX Param5, Sidechn type(when POST-FX type is compress).

Left out, mod sources and targets: a number above 127 moves to another VV, and the spec does not list them: Macro1 Target, Macro2 Target, Macro3 Target, Macro4 Target, Macro5 Target, Macro6 Target, Macro7 Target, Macro8 Target, ModMatrix Mod Source, ModMatrix Mod Target.
Left out, commands, not settings: All notes off, All notes off and effect silence.
Left out, two rows the spec gives the same NRPN and VV (3FH 04H, VV 06H): LFO1 Smooth and ENV5 Loop.
Left out, two rows the spec gives the same NRPN and VV (3FH 04H, VV 07H): LFO1 Steps and ENV5 Legato.
